race.description: Book In Your Work Xmas Party 4th Dec C,G&E Hcp (58)
race.comment: ROCKRATA (12) is the one to beat after missing by a nose at Ipswich last week, with that effort backed by a sound record at this track and enough wet-track grounding to suit the soft conditions. He also beat LANGAN in that race, which gives the line extra relevance. On top. LANGAN (9) still has a strong case as a lightly raced three-year-old who was beaten just under three lengths despite covering ground, and Tahlia Fenlon has already won on him, though his 1400m record remains the main reservation. LYRICAL GANGSTER (4) has been safely held at Sunshine Coast at his past two, but he has won at around 1400m and looks capable of improving enough to be in the minors. TULONG (3) performed well last start when second at Ipswich over 1350m. Looks a top challenger.
